name: tnil-obsidian
description: This a plugin for rendering TNIL (New Ithkuil) in Obsidian

scripts.release: npm run build && mkdir -p ./builds/latest/tnil-obsidian && cp ./styles.css ./main.js ./builds/latest/tnil-obsidian && zip ./builds/latest/tnil-obsidian.zip ./builds/latest/tnil-obsidian/{styles.css,main.js}
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
